program_name: Nexo Affiliate Program (Affiliate track / Business track)
application_conditions: 'Request invitation' → on-page form (nexo.com/eea/affiliate#form): first name, last name, email, 'What best describes you?' (Adviser / KOL-Creator / Affiliate-Media / Other), preferred contact besides email (Telegram / WhatsApp / LinkedIn), checkbox 'I have a Nexo Partner reference'. Partnership Team replies 'within one business day'. No minimum audience; judged on fit and 'Value First' standard. Affiliate track then runs on Impact, Business track on Nexo Partner Portal (2026-11-04).
paid_action: Share of fee revenue: trading fees, credit interest/loan volume, yield, futures; 'Nexo Card transactions' listed without a rate.

commission.model_note: Up to 50% of trading fees; up to 50% of interest revenue or up to 4% of loan volume; up to 10% of yield; card rate not stated; varies by track, region, tier.

revenue_share.included_products: Exchange, credit, yield, futures, card (rate unstated), private clients
revenue_share.exclusions: Products not available in all jurisdictions

rules_note: Affiliate track on Impact; Business track on Nexo Partner Portal. Some products cannot be advertised freely; no channel rules published.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; product availability varies by jurisdiction.

evidence.title: Nexo Affiliate Program page + FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Two tracks; up to 50% of fee revenue; Nexo Card transactions listed as a revenue source without a rate; withdrawals every 30 days.

evidence.title: Nexo Affiliate Program (EEA page) + form
evidence.excerpt: Up to 50% of fee revenue; 'Nexo Card: earnings on client transactions' (no rate); card issued by DiPocket UAB; payouts bank transfer or crypto, withdrawal once every 30 days; form fields: name, email, role, Telegram/WhatsApp/LinkedIn, partner reference.

notes: Card eligibility itself needs >$5,000 portfolio for cashback; commission depends on referred users' fee-generating activity. 2026-11-04: application form fields recorded; second programme to apply to (card transactions are a named revenue source).
